title: Everyday Phrases — Brunch with Friends
title_quote: Hey, are you free this Sunday?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🥞 實用早午餐必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Brunch with Friends
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用的早午餐情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從群組約時間訂位、看菜單點班尼迪克蛋和松餅、分食加單聊近況，到結帳分攤、打包剩食、約好下次，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Brunch with Friends phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the full Sunday brunch journey: texting to meet and booking a table, ordering eggs Benedict and pancakes, sharing dishes, refills and small talk, splitting the bill, packing leftovers and planning the next meetup. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, are you free this Sunday?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want to try that new brunch place?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt tu traɪ ðæt nu brʌntʃ pleɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 想不想去試那家新的早午餐店？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is called Sunny Side Cafe.
dialogue.zh: 叫做 Sunny Side 咖啡館。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I saw it on my phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us meet there around ten.
dialogue.zh: 我們十點左右在那邊見面吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten is better, I am hungry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, me too, ten it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we book a table first?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their app lets you reserve online.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just us, a table for two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will book it right now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, ask for a window seat.
dialogue.zh: 好，順便要求靠窗的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything you do not eat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ju du nɑt it?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我很幸運什麼都吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 有沒有需要注意的過敏？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: None for me, but Sam hates mushrooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /nʌn fər mi, bʌt sæm heɪts ˈmʌʃruːmz./
dialogue.zh: 我沒有，但 Sam 討厭蘑菇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I invited the whole group.
dialogue.zh: 對，我把整個群組都邀了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many is our group now?
dialogue.zh: 我們這一團現在有幾個人？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then two tables or one big one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tu ˈteɪbəlz ɔr wʌn bɪɡ wʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 那要兩張桌還是一張大桌？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will change it to a big table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tʃeɪndʒ ɪt tu ə bɪɡ ˈteɪbəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they text back about the table?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðeɪ tɛkst bæk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈteɪbəl?/
dialogue.zh: 他們回覆桌子的訊息了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it to the chat, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Already done, with a map link.
dialogue.zh: 早就傳好了，還附了地圖連結。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 週日早上，我很早就出門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am already stuck on Main Street.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ɔlˈrɛdi stʌk ɑn meɪn strit./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 大約二十分鐘，動也不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app says all roads are slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp sɛz ɔl roʊdz ər sloʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 呃，都是週日早午餐的人潮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you close to the cafe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I just parked across the street.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chill, brunch is not going away.
dialogue.zh: 放輕鬆，早午餐不會跑掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see you through the window!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will hold the door, come in.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl hoʊld ðə dɔr, kʌm ɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finally, hello, long time no see.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has been one whole week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You look well, slept a lot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，睡了十一小時，超舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, where are Sam and Mia?
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，Sam 和 Mia 人呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好，我們的桌子準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The host put us by the plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊst pʊt ʌs baɪ ðə plænts./
dialogue.zh: 外場把我們安排在植物旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, here come Sam and Mia!
dialogue.zh: 看，Sam 和 Mia 來了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There you both are, right on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ju boʊθ ər, raɪt ɑn taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 你們倆到齊了，時間剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, we just sat down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The traffic out there was a nightmare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈtræfɪk aʊt ðɛr wʌz ə ˈnaɪtˌmɛr./
dialogue.zh: 外頭的車陣簡直是惡夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the lot behind the park.
dialogue.zh: 下次停公園後面的停車場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip, we will try it next time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd tɪp, wi wɪl traɪ ɪt nɛkst taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 好建議，下次我們就停那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們都在等大家到齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is your sister doing these days?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɪz jʊr ˈsɪstər ˈduɪŋ ðiz deɪz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Busy, but she loves her new place.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪzi, bʌt ʃi lʌvz hɜr nu pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 很忙，但她很愛她的新公寓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can talk while we eat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am so hungry it hurts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same, skipping breakfast was a mistake.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，不吃早餐是錯的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, I am starving now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will go ask for water.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get some for me too, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你今天簡直是我們的英雄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 對了，大家到底停在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I barely found a spot, two blocks away.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈbɛrli faʊnd ə spɑt, tu blɑks əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我好不容易在兩個街區外找到車位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should do this every week.
dialogue.zh: 我們應該每週都來這一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 週日早午餐俱樂部，正式成立。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我已經很喜歡這名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now, shall we look at menus?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這些菜單也太大張了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 裡面的每樣東西都好好吃的樣子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know, it is so hard.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Salmon is great too, you know.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 要酪奶松餅還是藍莓松餅？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是真楓糖漿還是香料的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check the label here.
dialogue.zh: 讓我看看這標籤寫什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No hurry, I am curious too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says real maple, lucky us.
dialogue.zh: 寫的是真楓糖，我們好運。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The omelet is made to order.
dialogue.zh: 歐姆蛋是可以現點現做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 蘑菇先免了，記得 Sam 嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, right, no mushrooms for him.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will get an egg white omelet.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ɡɛt ən ɛɡ waɪt ɑmlət./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fancy, are you on a diet?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 糖會蓋掉咖啡豆的香味。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do they have fresh juice here?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 來一杯柳丁汁，不要果肉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good call, pulp is the worst.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if it is not too sweet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ɪt ɪz nɑt tu swit./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在聽芒果兩個字就超誘人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們的服務生來了，備好？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! One Benedict, and one stack.
dialogue.zh: 嗨！一份班尼迪克蛋，一疊松餅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a blueberry stack for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That one is mine, no mushrooms.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For drinks, two coffees, one OJ.
dialogue.zh: 飲料要兩杯咖啡、一杯柳丁汁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wrote it all down fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope the food comes soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am already smelling the bacon.
dialogue.zh: 我已經聞到隔壁桌的培根。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the coffee is already here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect timing, my hands are cold.
dialogue.zh: 時間來得正好，我手好冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, you are the best.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Save some room, food is coming.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you know the wait time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 早午餐通常要等二十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For the group chat, of course.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 總是她挑的角度最好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們的餐點會變成網紅款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 班尼迪克蛋看起來很完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我的松餅聞起來像甜點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你的看起來甜甜鬆軟，好完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, and take the syrup too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在我們終於能開動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 敬早午餐，還有關掉的鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這荷蘭醬簡直無可挑剔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你已經吃過一口了，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 坐在早午餐桌上還吟起詩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在換你嚐嚐我的歐姆蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們可以再來一杯咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好啊，我那杯已經見底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is Sam, by the way?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A fancy place with good eggs.
dialogue.zh: 有高檔感的蛋料理小店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 松餅也更厲害，顯而易見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which team are you, sweet or salty?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ tim ər ju, swit ɔr ˈsɔlti?/
dialogue.zh: 你是甜食派還是鹹食派？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在早午餐桌上，兩派都要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will quote you on that.
dialogue.zh: 我要把你這句話掛在嘴邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saving the last bite for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 差一點點，不過糖漿還是贏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, any news about the job?
dialogue.zh: 對了，那份工作有消息了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 什麼？這是天文級好消息！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 噓，先吃你的班尼迪克蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 就用咖啡代替一下也好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你什麼時候要到新公司？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 跟 Mia 去海邊，十天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在沙灘上吃早午餐也算數吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那旁邊得要有鬆餅才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will find a place there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 鋪滿草莓在上面，太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 還是同一位服務生，真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 她還記得我們點過什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That kind of service is rare.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 免費續杯直接改寫人生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You will say that every Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 你以後每個週日都會這樣講。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and it will stay true.
dialogue.zh: 是啊，而且它會永遠是真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 好啦算你說，果醬遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fig jam? Where did this come from?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪɡ dʒæm? wɛr dɪd ðɪs kʌm frʌm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 也只有 Mia 會這樣安排了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She plans brunch like a boss.
dialogue.zh: 她安排早午餐超有首領範。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pass me the fork, this looks good.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæs mi ðə fɔrk, ðɪs lʊks ɡʊd./
dialogue.zh: 叉子給我，看起來好好吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not eat all of it!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太慢了，已經進我肚子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, the jam won me over.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，是果醬收買了我的心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你今天早上真的太離譜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, did you hear about Leo?
dialogue.zh: 對了，你有聽到 Leo 的事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one who cooks? What news?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is opening a small cafe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 下個早午餐聖地，就是它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們應該帶個開幕禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一盆植物，還是講究的餐巾？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A plant, that place needs green.
dialogue.zh: 送植物吧，他那間店需要綠色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like the ones by our table.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I also get the last waffle.
dialogue.zh: 我也順便拿走了最後一塊華夫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice logic, I do not buy it.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ˈlɑdʒɪk, aɪ du nɑt baɪ ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們從來沒有不是朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Told you it was not sweet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is sweet, but in a good way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz swit, bʌt ɪn ə ɡʊd weɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it is exactly sweet enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am so full, absolutely stuffed.
dialogue.zh: 我吃得好飽，整個撐壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, that was a feast.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，這真的是一大餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we get the check, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You are so prepared for this.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here she comes with the bill.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, is that with the extras?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有，培根、華夫餅都算進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us just split it fifty-fifty.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs dʒʌst splɪt ɪt ˈfɪfti ˈfɪfti./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一人一半，最簡單的方法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will pay by card, okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, I will give you my half.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil, aɪ wɪl ɡɪv ju maɪ hæf./
dialogue.zh: 成交，我把我那一份給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write the tip on the slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt ðə tɪp ɑn ðə slɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我會把小費金額寫在單子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good plan, do we tip big?
dialogue.zh: 好主意，小費要多給一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這服務真的值這個小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你那一份給現金就可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here is twenty four, all set.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 完美，點清了，我們兩不相欠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你簡直是我們的小費專家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 輕鬆搞定，沒什麼好緊張的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cheap, for a fancy place, right?
dialogue.zh: 對這種講究的店來說真的便宜，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 又便宜又好吃，還求什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 確實，以這品質來說算便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A steal, if you ask me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can we get a box, please?
dialogue.zh: 可以給我們一個打包盒嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will ask for two boxes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One for the waffle, one for eggs.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fər ðə ˈwɑfəl, wʌn fər ɛɡz./
dialogue.zh: 一個裝華夫餅，一個裝蛋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bacon can join the waffle.
dialogue.zh: 培根就跟華夫餅擠一起吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這是早午餐的打包數學，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 明天的我們會感謝現在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fridge is our cafe now.
dialogue.zh: 冰箱現在就是我們的咖啡館。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last photo of the table?
dialogue.zh: 幫桌上拍最後一張好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Post it to the chat now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam, of course, Sam loves brunch.
dialogue.zh: 當然是 Sam，他愛死早午餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but we need a new place.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt wi nid ə nu pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 好啊，但我們要找家新店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I heard the corner place is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd ðə ˈkɔrnər pleɪs ɪz ɡʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The one with the big sign?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will send the invite tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make it ten again, no changes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten is our brunch time now.
dialogue.zh: 十點就是我們的早午餐時段了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doing what, he did not say?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 帶著狗來吃早午餐？太可愛了吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is dog sitting, all week.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 可憐的 Sam，那沒鬆餅吃了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will save him a bite.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bite, very generous of us.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grab your jacket, it is chilly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, balanced like a pro.
dialogue.zh: 拿到了，端得像專業人士。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Walk slow, the box is hot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bye, thank you, it was lovely!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 外場人員跟我們揮手了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 她把我們當成常客對待。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are regulars? I love that.
dialogue.zh: 我們是常客？我喜歡這說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 常客才能坐靠窗的桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 到了外面，太陽照得好舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A post brunch glow, warm and real.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə poʊst brʌntʃ ɡloʊ, wɔrm ænd ril./
dialogue.zh: 飯後的好氣色，真實又溫暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a nap after this.
dialogue.zh: 吃完這頓我需要個午覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my car, the parking app!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Extend it now, two more hours.
dialogue.zh: 現在就延長，再加兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The walk there is five minutes.
dialogue.zh: 走到車那邊只要五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us go, box in hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是什麼？你看起來很認真。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你把今天這局組起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the pancakes were this good?
dialogue.zh: 等等，鬆餅真的有這麼好吃？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good plan, I am serious now.
dialogue.zh: 好計畫，我這回是認真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you, boxes safe with me.
dialogue.zh: 再見，打包盒我會拿好的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 開車小心，我慢慢走回去。
